summary: Red Cat Holdings filed an 8-K to report its completed acquisition of Quaze Technologies Inc. on May 19, 2026. Red Cat, through a wholly-owned subsidiary, acquired all Quaze shares for approximately 1,923,308 shares of common stock valued at ~$21 million based on a 20-day VWAP, with up to $5 million in additional earnout shares tied to integration, revenue, and gross margin milestones. The closing shares were issued unregistered under the Securities Act. The filing provides no board recommendation or advisor; the deal closed immediately. Watch for earnout achievement and integration of Quaze's Canadian drone technology into Red Cat's defense portfolio.
